description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TracksListAdapter for displaying a list of music tracks, with functionality for adding tracks to different decks and removing tracks, used in the UI layer of an Android music application.

classes.name: TracksListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for listing tracks in the library and adding to decks, extending ListAdapter to manage TrackItem objects with diffing capabilities.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for a track item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: VH
methods.description: Inner ViewHolder class managing the UI components for a track item, including binding data and setting click listeners.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TrackItem to the ViewHolder's views and sets up click listeners for actions.
